notes: Controlled vocabulary for tagging Jakubzick Lab publications (immunology: mononuclear phagocytes, lung immunity, natural antibodies, cancer). Tags are assigned from the abstract (and full text where available). 'topic' and 'approach' are multi-valued; 'type' is single-valued. Chip colour = axis colour.

values.label: Macrophages
values.def: Tissue-resident or recruited macrophages: alveolar, interstitial, serous-cavity, tumor-associated or other macrophages, their subsets, origin, niches or function.

values.label: Monocytes
values.def: Classical or non-classical blood monocytes, monocyte subsets, monocyte-derived cells, their trafficking, differentiation or antigen-presenting function.

values.label: Dendritic cells
values.def: Conventional (DC1, DC2), plasmacytoid or monocyte-derived dendritic cells, migratory DCs, Langerhans cells, their subsets, migration or function.

values.label: Antigen presentation & T cell priming
values.def: Antigen acquisition, cross-presentation, cis-activation, licensing of antigen-presenting cells, priming of CD4 or CD8 T cells, T cell responses or tolerance.

values.label: Lung immunity
values.def: Immune cells of the lung and airways, lung-draining lymph nodes, or lung diseases (asthma, fibrosis, cystic fibrosis, COPD, lung infection).

values.label: Cancer immunity
values.def: Tumor immunology: immune surveillance of neoantigen-expressing cells, tumor-associated myeloid cells, immunotherapy, cancer vaccines, melanoma or adenocarcinoma models.

values.label: Natural antibodies & B cells
values.def: Natural IgM/IgG, B1 cells, antibody-repertoire-deficient mice, or B cells and antibodies in immune surveillance or inflammation.

values.label: Chemokines & cell migration
values.def: Chemokines and their receptors (CCR2, CCR5, CCR7, CX3CR1, CCL5, CCL21 ...), leukocyte trafficking, migration to lymph nodes, or recruitment into tissues.

values.label: Fibrosis & tissue repair
values.def: Pulmonary fibrosis, fibroblasts, wound repair, tissue remodelling, or the reparative programs of myeloid cells.

values.label: Allergy & type 2 immunity
values.def: Asthma, allergic airway disease, IL-4/IL-13/Stat6 signalling, Th2 responses, IgE or eosinophils.

values.label: Infection
values.def: Viral, bacterial, fungal or parasitic infection (influenza, Schistosoma, Aspergillus ...), host defence or vaccines against pathogens.

values.label: Inflammation & sterile injury
values.def: Sterile inflammation, damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), inflammasome, colitis, steatohepatitis, or resolution of inflammation.

values.label: Cell death & efferocytosis
values.def: Apoptosis, efferocytosis, clearance of dead cells, myeloid cell turnover, or death-receptor signalling (Fas, c-FLIP).

values.label: Mouse–human homology
values.def: Cross-species comparison of immune cell subsets, human tissue immune cells, or translation of mouse findings to humans.

values.label: Other immune cells
values.def: The paper's focus is on cells other than mononuclear phagocytes and B cells: T cell subsets, NK cells, neutrophils, mast cells, stromal cells, or immune-system-wide profiling.

values.label: Single-cell & spatial omics
values.def: Single-cell RNA sequencing, CITE-seq, spatial transcriptomics (Xenium, Visium), or single-cell multi-omics.

values.label: Bulk transcriptomics
values.def: Microarray or bulk RNA-seq expression profiling, including ImmGen datasets.

values.label: Flow cytometry
values.def: Flow cytometry or cell sorting is a central method (phenotyping, gating strategies, isolation of subsets).

values.label: Mouse models
values.def: In vivo experiments in mice: knockout or transgenic strains, lineage tracing, adoptive transfer, cell depletion, bone-marrow chimeras or disease models.

values.label: Human tissue samples
values.def: Analysis of human lung, lymph node, blood, fluid or tumor samples.

values.label: Microscopy & imaging
values.def: Confocal or intravital microscopy, histology, stereology, time-lapse imaging, or imaging-based localization of cells.

values.label: Therapeutic intervention
values.def: Drugs, blocking or neutralizing antibodies, immunotoxins, vaccines, checkpoint or chemokine-receptor blockade tested as a treatment.

values.label: Computational analysis
values.def: Network analysis, gene-regulatory inference, machine learning or other bioinformatic analysis is a major contribution.

values.label: Methods & protocols
values.def: The paper describes or optimizes a protocol, a technique, standards or guidelines (e.g., cell isolation, flow cytometry reproducibility, venipuncture).

values.label: Consortium (ImmGen)
values.def: A consortium paper, e.g. from the Immunological Genome Project or an official society workshop report.

values.label: Empirical
values.def: Original research reporting new experimental data.

values.label: Review
values.def: Review, perspective or nomenclature proposal synthesizing the literature.

values.label: Methods
values.def: A protocol, methods paper or video article.

values.label: Commentary
values.def: Editorial, comment, preview, letter or news-and-views piece about others' work.

values.label: Book chapter
values.def: A chapter in an edited book or textbook.
